BiblicalUsage: Josiphiah is named once, in Ezra 8:10. In Ezra 8:10 we read, "And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males."
TheologicalSignificance: Josiphiah belonged to someone God knew, and I hold that every name in these lists did.
